metrics.source: synthetic 60 s 3840x2160 H.264 30 fps with AAC (the media worker's measurement clip)

notes: infra/preview/smoke-preview.sh (smoke-renders.sh, addendum to ADR 0092): media-render as the preview runs it (the render target of workers/media, 4096 MiB with no swap, 2 CPU, cpu_shares 128, read-only, Remotion concurrency 1, internal network only), restarted for a fresh cgroup, then given vertical circulated-template renders of a synthetic clip by the feeder, one at a time. memory.peak is the cgroup high-water mark with page cache; anon and scratch sampled every 0.5 s; idle is memory.current 5 s after the restart. render_s is started_at to completed_at in the API's record; feed_to_done_s adds the feeder's 3 s cycles. Synthetic content; not the shared server itself.
